content:
Thumbs and structured feedback

Per-message up/down with optional categories (accurate, helpful, slow, safety, etc.) to improve the product.

What this is

Each assistant message can receive thumbs up/down and optional tags (accurate, slow, safety, etc.) so Kahana can improve models and routing.

How to use it

  • Open feedback from the message footer.
  • Pick tags that best explain the issue; add detail text when prompted.
  • Thumbs do not change your quota; they are quality signals.

Notes and limits

Abuse or spam feedback may be rate limited server-side.
